details.about: This role is on the Backup Team within MongoDB Cloud Services, the group behind MongoDB Atlas, MongoDB's database-as-a-service. The Backup Team lets customers restore a massive, distributed database to any point in time at the click of a button, and works to make backup more reliable, faster and cheaper. It owns the Backup Agent (Go), server-side infrastructure (Java) that manages hundreds of terabytes of data and billions of operations a day, and the JavaScript interface customers use to manage backups.
duties: Work closely with product teams, keeping the user's perspective in mind
Collaborate with teammates on best practices and core concepts
Plan and execute major features, representing Engineering with Product and Design
Learn and contribute across all parts of the stack
Stay current with web engineering best practices
needs: Skill writing large-scale, distributed backend systems in a compiled language (Java, C#, Go, etc.)
Enjoy tracking down tough problems in distributed systems
Calm under pressure, with experience handling production incidents
Linux experience, including tying application performance problems to hardware limits
Comfortable working across the stack of a modern web application
Curious, collaborative and keen to keep learning
details.benefits: US base salary $101,000 – $273,000 a year; offers depend on skills, experience, qualifications and work location. Other benefits for eligible employees may include equity, the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks of fully paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, a 401(k) plan, mental health counseling and health benefits.
notes: MongoDB provides accommodations for candidates with disabilities during the application and interview process

yt_title: MongoDB Is Hiring: Senior Software Engineer (Backup Team) | New York, NY | $101K–$273K

scenes.head: The role
lines: Now hiring in New York City! MongoDB wants a Senior Software Engineer for the Backup Team behind MongoDB Atlas, its cloud database service.
The team makes backup more reliable, faster, and cheaper.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Go agent · Java backend · JavaScript UI
lines: You'll help customers restore huge databases to any point in time, working across a Go agent, a Java backend, and a JavaScript interface.
You'll also own the planning of major features with product and design.

scenes.head: What you need
bullets: Java, C#, Go or another compiled language
lines: You'll need experience building large-scale distributed backend systems in a compiled language like Java, C sharp, or Go, plus solid Linux skills and a cool head during production incidents.
